wizard.title: Import {{recordType}}
wizard.unsupported: This record type cannot be imported.

upload.title: Upload a CSV file or a spreadsheet
upload.description: The first line must hold the column names. CSV files in UTF-8 or Latin-1, separated by comma, semicolon, tab or pipe, and XLSX, XLS or ODS spreadsheets (first sheet only) are accepted.

mapping.title: Match columns to fields
mapping.description: We suggested a field for each column by its name. Adjust as needed; columns without a field are ignored.
mapping.createCompanies: Create companies that do not exist
mapping.saveFailed: The mapping could not be saved.

validation.title: Validation result
validation.note: Duplicates and module rules are checked while importing.
validation.more: Showing the first {{count}} rows with problems.

run.title: Importing…
run.hint: You can leave this page; the import keeps running and you will be notified when it ends.

result.fixHint: Fix the error file and upload it again: only the failed rows are imported, with the same mapping.
result.retryHint: Use it when the cause was outside the file, such as an owner who was not a member yet.

errors.load: The import could not be loaded.
errors.upload: The file could not be uploaded.

history.title: Imports
history.menuDescription: History of spreadsheet imports, with results and error files.
history.description: Track your imports, resume drafts and download the rows that failed.
history.emptyDescription: Use the Import button on a record list to get started.
